payload.title: P7 Move every site to guidelines as data and delete the repository files
payload.description:
What: per-site data moves, then code removal. Pilobolus first, then the other six in one batch.

Steps and files:
- Write publication writing documents with papyrus guidelines save --kind writing: from publications/anthus/style-profile.yml and publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml; others start empty (warning only)
- Re-save each visual style profile so its document is in S3
- Copy each section's NewsroomSection.visualStyle / visualGuidance into a section image document; then clear the old fields
- scripts/guidelines/migrate_site.py (dry-run plan by default, idempotent, prints per-site counts)
- After all seven: delete publications/*/style-profile.yml, publications/*/reference-samples/, publications/pilobolus/editorial-rewrite-skill.yml, the inline profile reader and the section field fallback
- features_backend/guidelines-migration.feature

Acceptance checks:
- For each site, resolve before and after migration gives the same effective image guidance.
- git grep finds no reader of style-profile.yml or reference-samples.
- Repo contains no publication voice wording outside data fixtures.

Gherkin scenarios:
- Migrating a site writes its writing guidelines from the old profile file
- Migrating a site moves its section visual guidance into section documents
- Running the migration twice changes nothing the second time
- The migration plan is shown without writing when asked for a dry run

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
